metadata.question: Did the Central Valley of California experience at least 15 inches of rainfall between October 2022 and March 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation dataset - Date: October 1, 2022 to March 31, 2023 (6-month period) - Location: Central Valley of California (approximate bounding box or representative polygon) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's a modeled precipitation product) - Just sum up the precipitation over the time period 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If total precipitation is 0-14.99 inches → Answer B (No) - Valid Result: If total precipitation ≥ 15 inches → Answer A (Yes) - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely for CHIRPS) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid value ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Central Valley of California geometry const centralValley = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-122.5, 35.0], [-122.5, 40.5], [-119.0, 40.5], [-119.0, 35.0], [-122.5, 35.0] ]); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2022-10-01'; const endDate = '2023-03-31'; // 3. Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(centralValley); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data found for the period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Sum precipitation over the period (mm) const totalPrecipMm = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 5. Calculate statistics const stats = totalPrecipMm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: centralValley, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = totalPrecipMm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: centralValley, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipMm = stats.precipitation; const pixels = pixelCount.precipitation; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixels}`); if (pixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total precipitation: ${precipMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Period: ${startDate} to ${endDate}`); // 6. Determine answer if (precipInches >= 15.0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
